newsitem.title: LATVIA: MISA PEAT PLANS 1997 PROFIT 10,000 LATS.
newsitem.headline: MISA PEAT PLANS 1997 PROFIT 10,000 LATS.

text.p: Misa Peat plans a 1997 lower profit of 10,000 lats as fuel prices were rising while peat prices were stable, shareholders said on Monday.
At a meeting on Saturday, shareholders also approved a plan to have income from sales of 751,000 lats.
The company came back into 1996 profit of 28,640 lats against a loss of 54,332 lats the previous year. Its turnover last year was 460,474 lats versus 377,551 lats in 1995.
Shareholders at a meeting on Saturday decided to retain all of the 1996 profit to cover operating costs during the non-productive part of the cycle.
Misa said this year's profit would be lower than in 1996 although production volumes would remain at last year's level.
Misa plans to start operating a new peat field this year, which will produce export quality peat.
It would be exported to Denmark, thereby opening a new market. Misa's only client at the moment is Riga heating plant.
